definitions.gloss: capture; catching; picking up (a signal or target)
definitions.explanation: Catching hold of something that is moving or hard to pin down: a target on radar, a signal, a fleeing person or vehicle. Also, less often, grasping a meaning. A formal, technical word.

examples.japanese: ⟦レーダー→レーダー：11708_reedaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{機影|きえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捕捉|ほそく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The radar picked up an aircraft.

examples.japanese: ⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捕捉|ほそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To pick up a signal from a satellite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{逃走|とうそう}→逃走：14403_tousou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}カメラ→防犯カメラ：07137_bouhankamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{捕捉|ほそく}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The getaway car was tracked down through security camera footage.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse it with ⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧ (supplement, additional note), which has the same reading and is far more common in everyday writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捕捉|ほそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lock onto a target
- {捕捉|ほそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧: hard to track or pin down

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{捕獲|ほかく}→捕獲：12881_hokaku⟧: capture (of animals)
- ⟦{把握|はあく}→把握：05625_haaku⟧: grasp, understanding
